context: Asuka and Mei discuss a biography.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: literature chat; biography vocabulary (人物/著/求める/ファン/かつ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この伝記の人物、本当に魅力的でした。
lines.en: The figure in this biography was truly fascinating.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 著者は、人物像を丁寧に描いていますね。
lines.en: The author depicts the figure carefully.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: その人は、優しくかつ強かったんですね。
lines.en: That person was kind yet strong.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm admiring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、理想を求め続けた人物です。
lines.en: Yes, a figure who kept seeking ideals.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 多くのファンが、彼を慕ったんですね。
lines.en: Many admirers looked up to him.
lines.style: warm woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: この著は、彼の手紙を基にしています。
lines.en: This work is based on his letters.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私も、すっかりファンになりました。
lines.en: I've completely become a fan too.
lines.style: delighted woman voice, soft warm bright delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 真実を求める姿が、心を打ちますね。
lines.en: His pursuit of truth is moving.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm reflective closing clarity throughout
